insert into t_three_d_buy_record ( code, `date`, lottery_number, buy_number,win_status,create_time,modify_time) values
( #{record.code}, #{record.date}, #{record.lotteryNumber}, #{record.buyNumber}, #{record.winStatus}, #{record.createTime}, #{record.modifyTime} )
